ios.desc:
Your duty is sworn in blood.  Join the blood rondo in a massive epic fantasy RPG to become the most powerful elven force in the realm! 

The acclaimed World of Blood RPG series features hundreds of hours of adventure, stories, quests, and powerful items. Find old and new friends in a dark and bloody world. 

FEATURES
- 100+ towns of adventures and action, spanning heaven and hell.
- 200+ items with powerful abilities.
- Chat with others and make new allies.
- Customize your character portrait.
- Battle with friends for extra rewards.
- Become a Legend on the leaderboards.
- Epic storyline

quotes.text:
OP here. My app finally got approved, I thought I'd share it with HN.  Here's the link:

http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/elven-blood/id875760225

It's a text-based RPG. Quite simple at first glance, but it features 100+ levels and hundreds of items, with a pretty awesome story too. The game builds in complexity and takes 2-3 weeks to finish I'd estimate.

Tech-wise, it's a hybrid native/uiwebview app, built in obj-c with php, mysql, html5/css3, and jquery. I coded it entirely myself over the course of a month. There are in-app purchases, but they are not necessary to complete the game, so please enjoy it.

Critique & criticism by all means welcome!
